summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K disclosing Amendment No.1 (dated Aug 27, 2026) to its July 3, 2026 securities purchase agreement with institutional investor Smart Mart Limited. The amendment reduced the floor price for pre-paid purchases of Class A ordinary shares (aggregate principal up to $31.5M, with $1.5M original issue discount) from $16.00 back to $0.20 per share, following a 1-for-80 reverse split. This is an equity financing instrument adjustment, not a classic special situation. The registrant is the issuer. Watch for potential dilution and share price impact under the revised floor.
